description: This file is a React component module for the 'Errors Tab' UI in a trace viewer application. It manages displaying error messages, related source code frames, and tools like copying error prompts. It uses various helper components and hooks to fetch and render error data, stack trace information, and source code snippets.

classes.name: CopyPromptButton
classes.description: A React functional component that renders a button to copy a prompt string to the clipboard.

methods.name: useErrorsTabModel
methods.description: Custom hook to create a model of errors from a TraceModel.

methods.name: ErrorView
methods.description: React component to display individual error message with optional source location and action.

methods.name: ErrorsTab
methods.description: Main React component to display a list of errors, with support for fetching code frames and copying error prompts.

methods.name: codeFrame
methods.description: Function to generate a formatted code snippet with the error line highlighted.
